question_summary: Request approval to substitute a tankless water heater in place of the specified storage-type unit in Spec Section 22 34 00 before material ordering and fixture rough-in.
proposed_solution: Substitute a tankless water heater in lieu of the specified storage-type unit.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day
routing_rationale: This is a Division 22 plumbing equipment substitution that requires the Plumbing EOR’s review for capacity, code compliance, venting/fuel, and coordination with electrical/mechanical.
